name: What maintenance is required for concrete hardscaping?

mainEntity.name: What maintenance is required for concrete hardscaping?

acceptedAnswer.text: Concrete hardscaping is relatively low maintenance. Regular cleaning with a hose and mild detergent is usually sufficient to keep surfaces looking good. For optimal longevity and appearance, it's recommended to reseal stamped or colored concrete every 2-5 years, depending on sun exposure and traffic. Promptly cleaning spills and addressing any cracks early can help preserve the integrity and aesthetic of your concrete features.
acceptedAnswer.description: Concrete hardscaping requires low maintenance, primarily regular cleaning. Resealing stamped or colored concrete every 2-5 years is recommended for longevity and appearance.
